features.description: A node:test reporter and the check file tests/checks/00-unit-tier.sh carry a unit tier (tests/unit/*.test.mjs, one node process) into tests/run.sh as PASS/FAIL lines; the testcount.mjs eval is its first moved test; CLAUDE.md names the tier and the node floor 22.8.
steps: Checks written first, watched red, in `tests/checks/33-suite-runner.sh`, each on a throwaway unit directory passed as `TEST_UNIT_DIR=$T/u1` to `bash tests/checks/00-unit-tier.sh` (the one variable, as `TEST_CHECKS` points the runner elsewhere): a file `a.test.mjs` with `test("a")` passing and `test("b")` failing on `assert.equal(1, 2)` prints exactly `PASS a`, then `FAIL b`, then at least one line starting with two spaces holding `1` and `2` (the node:assert diff), then its own `N/M checks passed` line and nothing else on stdout, exit 1; a passing-only file prints `PASS a` and exits 0; a file calling `process.exit(3)` at import prints `FAIL unit tier: node --test exited 3 with no FAIL line` (a file that throws at import gets node's own `FAIL <file path>` line from the test:fail event: both shapes are red, the check accepts either); `node --check tests/unit/reporter.mjs` passes; `grep -q 'node ≥ 22.8' CLAUDE.md`. Each new check's name is added to `tests/fixtures/check-names.txt` in LC_ALL=C order.

`tests/unit/reporter.mjs`: a `node:test` custom reporter (an async generator over the events, as the Node docs' example, one-line usage header): on `test:pass` it yields `PASS <name>\n`; on `test:fail` `FAIL <name>\n` followed by the failure's message lines each indented two spaces; on `test:diagnostic` and `test:stderr` nothing; nothing else on stdout. Tests are flat (no describe, no subtests), so `<name>` is the fixture's name.

`tests/checks/00-unit-tier.sh` (sorts first, does not source `tests/lib.sh`): from the repo root runs `node --test --test-isolation=none --test-reporter="$HERE/../unit/reporter.mjs" --test-reporter-destination=stdout "${TEST_UNIT_DIR:-$HERE/../unit}"/*.test.mjs`, prints its lines, then `N/M checks passed` from its own count of PASS/FAIL lines, exit 1 on any FAIL line or a non-zero node exit; a non-zero exit with no FAIL line prints `FAIL unit tier: node --test exited <rc> with no FAIL line` so the runner's no_fail rule has its line.

The first moved test: the `testcount.mjs: the runner's last N/M checks passed is the count` eval in `tests/checks/33-suite-runner.sh` becomes `tests/unit/testcount.test.mjs` (`import { test } from "node:test"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"`, the module imported by a path relative to the test file, two directories up to `lib/testcount.mjs`), one `assert.equal` per value the eval compared (325, 12, 7, null); the bash line is deleted; `bash tests/run.sh 00-unit 33-suite` prints that name once and ends with `PASS conformance: every check a subset ran is in the fixture, once`.

`CLAUDE.md`: in Code rules the floor reads `node ≥ 22.8` and the pure-functions phrase reads `unit-tested in tests/unit/<module>.test.mjs under node --test` in place of the `node --input-type=module -e` phrase; the rule `Every behaviour the driver or CLI gains … gets a check in a tests/checks/ file` gains `a pure function's behaviour gets a test in tests/unit/, not a stub run`; How to verify gains one sentence naming `node --test --test-isolation=none tests/unit/` (the tier alone, spec reporter), `bash tests/run.sh 00-unit` (the suite's lines) and `--test-name-pattern`. `bash tests/run.sh 39-memlint 37-memory 79-suite-length` stays green (the CHECK_KEY_MAP files for CLAUDE.md).

The decision file `journal/decisions/2026-11-03-unit-tier.md` (title, provenance, then finding · choice · rejected) records every default marked *default*: the reporter over a TAP parser in bash, `TEST_UNIT_DIR` as one variable read by `00-unit-tier.sh`, the CLAUDE.md rule, `--test-isolation=none`; rejected: TAP parsed in bash, a second runner (Vitest), keeping the evals, `--test-isolation=process`, a collection pass for the names (no list mode: the fixture stays); an empty `## Kept evals` section for U1-02 to U1-04 and a `## Measured` placeholder for U1-05.

`bash -n tests/checks/00-unit-tier.sh tests/checks/33-suite-runner.sh`; `node --check` on `tests/unit/reporter.mjs` and every `tests/unit/*.test.mjs`; `node --test --test-isolation=none tests/unit/` prints no `✖` line.
the suite is green (a full run: its `conformance: the split suite has every check the single-file suite had` line is PASS with the new names in the fixture)

features.description: The 37 evals of tests/checks/51-view-pure.sh and tests/checks/12-journal-pure-e4-entrys.sh become tests in tests/unit/view.test.mjs and tests/unit/entries.test.mjs with their exact names and every compared value asserted; the full run's conformance proves no name was lost.
steps: `tests/unit/view.test.mjs`: every `check "<name>" 'node --input-type=module -e …'` of `tests/checks/51-view-pure.sh` becomes `test("<exact old name>", () => { … })`: the shared prelude (`ctx`, `U`, `A`, `at`) as module constants that no test mutates, each value the eval compared asserted with `assert.equal`, `assert.deepEqual` or `assert.match` on the value itself (never `assert.ok` where the eval compared a string or number; an eval of three branches is three assertions in one test); the bash line deleted. The first check's bash part (usage header, `node --check`, imports only `node:`) stays a bash check and loses only its node part, listed under `## Kept evals` in `journal/decisions/2026-11-03-unit-tier.md` with one line of why.

`tests/unit/entries.test.mjs` the same for `tests/checks/12-journal-pure-e4-entrys.sh` (`entries.mjs`, with `features.mjs`'s `evidence` where the eval imported it); an eval that read a file the check file wrote (`bad-entry.json`, `out-entry.json`) either keeps its bash part (the `node lib/entries.mjs validate` CLI run is bash behaviour) or builds the same bytes under `fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), …))` and removes them; no test calls `process.exit`, writes outside `os.tmpdir()`, or keeps module-level mutable state.

Test-first: each new test file is run once with one deliberately wrong expected value and seen red (`node --test tests/unit/view.test.mjs` prints a `✖` line and the assert diff), then corrected and seen green; `node --test --test-isolation=none tests/unit/` prints no `✖` line.

A check file left with no checks is deleted (`git rm`); one left with non-eval checks keeps its name and its `source tests/lib.sh` line; `grep -c 'node --input-type=module' tests/checks/51-view-pure.sh tests/checks/12-journal-pure-e4-entrys.sh` prints 0 for each file that still exists; `node --check` on every `tests/unit/*.test.mjs`; `bash -n` on every check file touched.
`git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) -- tests/fixtures/check-names.txt | grep -c '^-[^-]'` prints 0 (no moved name removed or renamed; the fixture changes only by U1-01's additions).
the suite is green (a full run's `conformance: the split suite has every check the single-file suite had` line is PASS: the proof the move lost nothing)

features.description: The evals of the nine smaller -pure- files (07-step-lint, 11-deploy-guards, 05-metrics, 03-harness-parked, 02-notifications, 06-test-counts, 04-render, 01-scheduler, 35-backlog) become tests in the module's tests/unit/<module>.test.mjs with their exact names; the full run's conformance proves no name was lost.
steps: Every `node --input-type=module` check of `tests/checks/07-step-lint-pure-r3.sh`, `11-deploy-guards-pure-and.sh`, `05-metrics-pure-tokens-cache.sh`, `03-harness-parked-pure-report.sh`, `02-notifications-pure-body-cap.sh`, `06-test-counts-pure-r1.sh`, `04-render-pure-sections-go.sh`, `01-scheduler-pure-after-may.sh` and `35-backlog-pure-m1.sh` becomes `test("<exact old name>", …)` in `tests/unit/<module>.test.mjs` named for the `lib/<module>.mjs` it imports (`features.test.mjs`, `deploy.test.mjs`, `metrics.test.mjs`, `parked.test.mjs`, `notify.test.mjs`, `testcount.test.mjs` (U1-01's file, extended), `render.test.mjs`, `backlog.test.mjs`), each compared value asserted with `assert.equal`/`assert.deepEqual`/`assert.match` on the value (never `assert.ok` where the eval compared a value); the bash line deleted.

An eval the bash wrapped as behaviour (a pipe into `grep`, a `node lib/<module>.mjs` CLI run, a comparison against a file the check file made, `widest` from `tests/lib.sh`, the `prompts/initializer.md` grep) stays a bash check; where the bash was only plumbing around a pure call the eval moves and builds its own input under `fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), …))`; each kept eval gets one line of why under `## Kept evals` in `journal/decisions/2026-11-03-unit-tier.md`.

Test-first: each new or extended test file is run once with one deliberately wrong expected value and seen red (`node --test tests/unit/<module>.test.mjs` prints a `✖` line), then corrected; `node --test --test-isolation=none tests/unit/` prints no `✖` line; no test calls `process.exit`, writes outside `os.tmpdir()` or keeps module-level mutable state.

A check file left with no checks is deleted (`git rm`); one left with non-eval checks keeps its name; `grep -c 'node --input-type=module' tests/checks/0[1-7]-*.sh tests/checks/11-*.sh tests/checks/35-*.sh` prints 0 for every file still present; `node --check` on every `tests/unit/*.test.mjs`; `bash -n` on every check file touched.
`git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) -- tests/fixtures/check-names.txt | grep -c '^-[^-]'` prints 0 (no moved name removed or renamed).
the suite is green (a full run's `conformance: the split suite has every check the single-file suite had` line is PASS)

features.description: Every remaining node --input-type=module eval in the scenario check files (74-flakes-run, 09-replay-set, 85-suite-runs, 70-overlap, 68-show, 64-needs-review, 63-question-locations, 42, 41, 38, 37, 84, 82, 81, 78, 76, 73, 71, 59, 58, 57, 52, 43, 14, 10) moves to tests/unit or is kept with a reason; fewer than 10 eval lines remain in tests/checks.
steps: Each remaining `node --input-type=module` line in `tests/checks/*.sh` (`grep -n 'node --input-type=module' tests/checks/*.sh` lists them; `tests/checks/33-suite-runner.sh`'s moved in U1-01) is read with the check it serves: an eval whose check is a pure call on literal input moves to `tests/unit/<module>.test.mjs` under the exact old name with every compared value asserted (`assert.equal`/`assert.deepEqual`/`assert.match`, never `assert.ok` for a compared value); one whose bash part is the behaviour (a helper function such as `in_node` or `keymaplint` used by several checks on `$T` state, a stub run's output read from `$T`, a pipe into `grep`, a `node lib/<module>.mjs` CLI run) stays, with one line of why under `## Kept evals` in `journal/decisions/2026-11-03-unit-tier.md`.

No test under `tests/unit/` reads the repo's `CLAUDE.md`, `prompts/` or `templates/` (`grep -l 'CLAUDE.md\|prompts/\|templates/' tests/unit/*.test.mjs` prints nothing): an eval that does stays a bash check, since `CHECK_KEY_MAP` in `.harness/config.sh` names the check files that read CLAUDE.md and `tests/checks/82-key-map-lint.sh` lints only `tests/checks/`; `bash tests/run.sh 82-key-map 37-memory` stays green.

`grep -c 'node --input-type=module' tests/checks/*.sh | awk -F: '{ s += $2 } END { print s }'` prints a number under 10, and every line it counts is listed under `## Kept evals` in `journal/decisions/2026-11-03-unit-tier.md`.
`git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) -- tests/fixtures/check-names.txt | grep -c '^-[^-]'` prints 0 (no moved name removed or renamed).

features.description: findings-and-research/2026-11-03-unit-tier.md holds the before/after table of the spec (node starts of the unit layer, CPU of the pure files, the tier's wall alone, the solo full suite's wall and CPU, check names) measured on the base commit and on this tree with no other suite alive.
steps: Before each timed run `harness status` is run and its output kept beside the row (`RUNNING 1`, this run alone, and the queue runner's line); when another run is alive the session polls `harness status` every 60 s for up to 30 min, then measures anyway and writes `/proc/loadavg`'s first three numbers beside the row as the caveat.

Before rows, in a scratch clone of the base commit (`git clone -q . /tmp/harness/agent-harness/agent-harness-2026-11-03-2/before && git -C /tmp/harness/agent-harness/agent-harness-2026-11-03-2/before checkout -q $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)`, removed with `rm -rf` of that clone directory at the end): `strace -f -e trace=execve -o <scratch>/before.strace bash tests/run.sh 01-scheduler 02-notifications 03-harness-parked 04-render-pure 05-metrics-pure 06-test-counts 07-step-lint 11-deploy 12-journal 35-backlog 51-view-pure` (the eleven -pure- files by name, as `findings-and-research/2026-11-03-redesign-baseline.md` §5.3 ran them) counting successful `execve` lines whose binary ends in `/node` (no `= -1`); `command time -v` (GNU time) user+sys and wall of the same command without strace; the same with `TEST_JOBS=1`.

After rows, in this worktree: the same three measurements over `bash tests/run.sh 00-unit` plus every -pure- file that still exists and every check file that still holds a `node --input-type=module` line (`grep -l` lists them), and `command time -v node --test --test-isolation=none tests/unit/` alone (its wall is the tier's time-to-signal, its node execs counted under strace).

The solo full suite before (the scratch clone) and after (this worktree), each started after the other ended and after `harness status`, as the baseline's §5.1: `systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=3G command time -v env TEST_JOBS=4 bash tests/run.sh > <scratch>/solo-<before|after>.out 2> <scratch>/solo-<before|after>.time` under a `timeout 40m`; each `.out` ends `N/M checks passed` with its `conformance` line PASS, and the findings file quotes both lines and the fixture's line count (`wc -l < tests/fixtures/check-names.txt`) for each tree.

`findings-and-research/2026-11-03-unit-tier.md`: how measured (commands, trees, `harness status` and load before each run, the files kept under `/tmp/harness/agent-harness/agent-harness-2026-11-03-2/`), then one table with columns measure · predicted · before · after · verdict and the spec's five rows (node starts of the unit layer; CPU of the pure files; `node --test tests/unit/` wall alone; full suite solo wall and CPU; check names), the predicted column copied from `docs/specs/2026-11-03-unit-tier.md`'s table and the baseline's §5.3 row cited as the measured before (149 node execs there); a miss recorded as a miss with its number; `journal/decisions/2026-11-03-unit-tier.md`'s `## Measured` line points at the file.
the suite is green

features.description: Review + simplify of U1: an Opus reviewer reads the milestone diff from a file (every translated assertion against its eval, module-level state, the reporter's multi-line failures), Critical/Important findings are fixed RED→GREEN, simplifications applied, and docs/architecture.md and README.md describe the unit tier.
steps: The milestone diff is written to `/tmp/harness/agent-harness/agent-harness-2026-11-03-2/u1-review.diff` (`git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) HEAD -- . ':!.harness'`) and an Opus subagent reviews it from that file, reading hardest: every `test(…)` against the eval it replaced in the diff's deleted lines (a weakened assertion: `assert.ok(x)` or a missing branch where the eval compared a value), module-level mutable state in any `tests/unit/*.test.mjs`, `tests/unit/reporter.mjs`'s handling of a failure message with newlines (every line indented), `tests/checks/00-unit-tier.sh`'s exit paths and `TEST_UNIT_DIR`; its findings with severities (Critical/Important/Minor) written to `/tmp/harness/agent-harness/agent-harness-2026-11-03-2/u1-review.md`; one round, a second only when the first found something Critical.

Every Critical and Important finding is fixed RED→GREEN (a weakened assertion restored to the eval's comparison with the test seen red on a wrong value first); simplification passes applied where safe: one shared prelude per test file, dead helpers or preludes left in check files whose evals moved deleted, `tests/unit/*.test.mjs` each with a one-line usage header; the kept and fixed list summarised in the `entry.json`.

`docs/architecture.md`'s tests row names the unit tier: `tests/unit/<module>.test.mjs` under `node --test --test-isolation=none`, `tests/unit/reporter.mjs` printing `PASS`/`FAIL` lines, `tests/checks/00-unit-tier.sh` as the check file that carries it into every full run, `TEST_UNIT_DIR`; `README.md` says how to run the unit tier alone (`node --test --test-isolation=none tests/unit/`) and under the suite (`bash tests/run.sh 00-unit`); `journal/decisions/2026-11-03-unit-tier.md` is complete (every default marked *default*, `## Kept evals` listing every surviving eval line, `## Measured` pointing at `findings-and-research/2026-11-03-unit-tier.md`).

`node --check` on `tests/unit/reporter.mjs` and every `tests/unit/*.test.mjs`; `bash -n` on every `tests/checks/*.sh`; `node --test --test-isolation=none tests/unit/` prints no `✖` line; `bash tests/run.sh 00-unit 33-suite 82-key-map 39-memlint` is green.
the suite is green
